description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Zeid)] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Zeid)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =50%/100% after casting 1/2+ Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Zeid)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Zeid)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark abilities, grants [Deadly Strikes +20% 1] and [Quick Cast 1] to the user if the user has less than 750 SB points, grants [Buff Dark 30% (5s)] and [Deadly Strikes +20% 3] to the user if the user has 750+ SB points, causes [Soul Break Gauge -250] to the user if the user has 750+ SB points

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Buff Dark 30% (5s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Deadly Strikes +20% 3
description.text: Critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
